commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/bloomml-ipo-nvs-matrix.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --branch main https://github.com/MichalMatu/bloomml.git "$WORK/source"
cd "$WORK/source"
EXPECTED="347bcca2901cd4e5d4b52bf27301cad27411ce2a"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
echo "SOURCE_SHA|$EXPECTED"
cmake -S test/host -B build/ipo-hwq -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug
cmake --build build/ipo-hwq --target ipo_nvs_journal_tests --parallel 2
ctest --test-dir build/ipo-hwq -R '^ipo_nvs_journal_tests$' --output-on-failure
echo "PRODUCTION_NVS_ADAPTER_FAULT_MATRIX|PASS"
cmake --build build/ipo-hwq --target stage28d_lamp_safety_tests stage27_fault_freshness_tests output_runtime_lifecycle_control_tests --parallel 2
ctest --test-dir build/ipo-hwq -R '^(stage28d_lamp_safety_tests|stage27_fault_freshness_tests|output_runtime_lifecycle_control_tests)$' --output-on-failure
echo "SAFETY_RELEVANT_NARROW_REGRESSIONS|PASS"
git diff --check
echo "DIFF_CHECK|PASS"
